title: SmokePing — Path analysis (mtr)
description: Per-hop loss and latency from the mtr probe. Every hop of every cycle is stored as its own row in smokeping.mtr_hops, so you can ask 'which router got slow' instead of only 'the path got slow'.

list.name: location
list.label: Agent location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent_location FROM smokeping.mtr_hops ORDER BY agent_location

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_name FROM smokeping.mtr_hops WHERE agent_location = '${location}' ORDER BY target_name

panels.title: Current path — the mtr table, as stored
panels.description: The most recent cycle, one row per hop. This is the familiar mtr report, except it is queryable history rather than a terminal snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hop_no                    AS "Hop",
  if(hop_ip = '', '???', hop_ip) AS "IP",
  hop_host                  AS "Host",
  asn                       AS "ASN",
  round(loss_pct, 1)        AS "Loss %",
  sent                      AS "Sent",
  round(best_ms, 2)         AS "Best",
  round(avg_ms, 2)          AS "Avg",
  round(worst_ms, 2)        AS "Worst",
  round(stddev_ms, 2)       AS "StDev"
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
  AND measurement_id = (
        SELECT measurement_id
        FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
        WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
          AND agent_location = '${location}'
          AND target_name    = '${target}'
        ORDER BY ts DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
ORDER BY hop_no

panels.title: Latency by hop — where the time is spent
panels.description: Average RTT to each hop over the selected window. A step between two adjacent hops is the segment that adds the latency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(toString(hop_no), '. ', if(hop_ip = '', '???', hop_ip)) AS hop,
  round(avg(best_ms), 2)  AS "Best",
  round(avg(avg_ms), 2)   AS "Avg",
  round(avg(worst_ms), 2) AS "Worst"
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
GROUP BY hop_no, hop_ip
ORDER BY hop_no

panels.title: Loss % by hop over time
panels.description: Read this the way you read an mtr table: loss that appears at one hop and disappears further along is ICMP rate limiting, not a problem. Loss that appears and persists to the destination is the real fault, and its first hop is the culprit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  concat(toString(hop_no), '. ', if(hop_ip = '', '???', hop_ip)) AS hop,
  avg(loss_pct) AS loss_pct
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
GROUP BY time, hop_no, hop_ip
ORDER BY time, hop_no

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  concat(toString(hop_no), '. ', if(hop_ip = '', '???', hop_ip)) AS hop,
  avg(avg_ms) AS avg_ms
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
  AND hop_ip != ''
GROUP BY time, hop_no, hop_ip
ORDER BY time, hop_no

panels.title: Hop latency heatmap
panels.description: Hop number on the y axis, time on the x axis, latency as colour. Congestion that walks along the path is obvious here in a way it is not in overlaid lines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  toString(hop_no)    AS hop,
  avg(avg_ms)         AS avg_ms
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
  AND hop_ip != ''
GROUP BY time, hop_no
ORDER BY time, hop_no

panels.title: Distinct paths observed
panels.description: path_signature is a stable hash of the responding hops, with silent (???) hops excluded so ICMP rate limiting cannot create phantom flaps. A step change here is a genuine reroute — correlate it with a latency shift on the panels above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  uniq(path_signature) AS distinct_paths
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
  AND path_signature != ''
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Observed paths
panels.description: Each distinct route taken during the window, with how often it was seen and the hops it used.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  path_signature                                      AS "Path",
  uniq(measurement_id)                                AS "Cycles",
  max(hop_no)                                         AS "Hops",
  arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(hop_ip), ' > ')    AS "Route",
  min(ts)                                             AS "First seen",
  max(ts)                                             AS "Last seen"
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
  AND path_signature != ''
GROUP BY path_signature
ORDER BY "Last seen" DESC

panels.title: End-to-end: destination latency and loss
panels.description: The destination hop only. Compare against the per-hop panels to see whether an end-to-end change was caused by a specific router.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  avg(avg_ms)   AS "Latency ms",
  avg(loss_pct) AS "Loss %"
FROM smokeping.mtr_hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND is_destination = 1
  AND agent_location = '${location}'
  AND target_name    = '${target}'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
